articles.title: Letter: The Street Tree Planting on Hickory Ridge Road Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I have lived on Hickory Ridge Road for 11 years, and I want to say what a difference the Cedar Hollow Garden Club has made. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the street tree planting in the budget. Many of us on Hickory Ridge Road use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting.
Isaac Whitcomb, Hickory Ridge
